about: Zeno Voice's function declarations, as mintLiveToken locks them into every ephemeral token (functions/src/zenoVoice.ts writes this file: npm run voice-tools). The app's ZenVoice keeps a copy and must handle exactly these tools and arguments.

tools.name: get_zen_status
tools.description: Read the user's ZenMode OS state on this device: Zen Score (0-10, one decimal), change today, minutes left in today's screen-time promise, good days this week, weekly streak, the open session, focus and paused apps.

tools.name: set_intent
tools.description: Start an intentional session: which app the user is opening, why, and for how many minutes. ZenMode OS shows a timer and nudges when the minutes are up.

app.description: App name, e.g. Instagram, YouTube, WhatsApp.

purpose.description: Why, in a few words, in English.

minutes.description: Minutes the user asked for, 1 to 180.

tools.name: end_session
tools.description: End the open intentional session. Pass overrun_minutes if the user went past the minutes they asked for.

tools.name: start_focus
tools.description: Start a focus session. Notifications hold on every screen on the account until it ends.

label.description: What the focus is for, in English.

quiet_apps.description: Apps to hold, if the user named any.

tools.name: pause_app
tools.description: Put a short pause (default 7 seconds) in front of an app, so opening it becomes a choice.

tools.name: log_reflection
tools.description: Save the user's spoken evening note as a Zen Card.

summary.description: One line in the user's own language and script, at most 280 characters. No scores, minutes or app names.

language.description: BCP-47 code of what the user spoke, e.g. ta, hi, en, ta-Latn, hi-Latn.

earned_back.description: What they earned back, in English, at most 40 characters.

drift.description: Where time slipped, if they said so, at most 80 characters.

tools.name: share_with_circle
tools.description: Share the latest Zen Card with the user's cohort: their display name, the summary, mood and language, never a score. Only call after the user says yes.

note.description: An optional short note for the cohort, at most 120 characters.
